a_artifacts_compared.note: A test artifacts compared after regeneration from the cached probability file

a_replay_wall_seconds.note: wall time of the A-layer regeneration (bootstrap included)

calibrator_replay_max_abs_diff.note: maximum absolute difference between the rebuilt p_s and the cached a_selected_test.p_s when the frozen heldout probabilities are replayed through the frozen calibrator

csv_parser_ulp_rows.note: cached p_s values changed by pandas default parsing versus float_precision=round_trip

dependent_chart_rows.note: regeneration-dependent observed chart values (not axis ticks)

entry_points.note: pipeline files whose hashes are recorded in the results JSON entry_points block

final_metrics_differing_keys.note: top-level keys whose parsed values differ

final_metrics_hash_equal.note: 1 if the re-emitted final_metrics.json is byte-identical to the frozen file

final_metrics_wall_seconds.note: wall time of the re-emission (no scoring)

ledger_affected_slides.note: distinct slide numbers carrying at least one regeneration-dependent row

ledger_rows_dependent.note: ledger rows whose displayed value is recomputed by the chain from per-row probabilities or selections

ledger_rows_narrative.note: v1 headline and frozen-search performance rows that regeneration does not recompute

ledger_rows_unaffected.note: protocol, financial, design, bibliography and axis rows

narrative_cv_rows.note: narrative rows describing the frozen candidate search

narrative_v1_rows.note: narrative rows bound to the frozen v1 summary

regeneration_effort_days.note: estimate: 0.5 d A/B/C wiring, 0.5 d charts+ledger+verification, 0.5 d contingency; no model fitting

regeneration_rows_slide_10.note: regeneration-dependent ledger rows displayed on slide 10

regeneration_rows_slide_11.note: regeneration-dependent ledger rows displayed on slide 11

regeneration_rows_slide_12.note: regeneration-dependent ledger rows displayed on slide 12

regeneration_rows_slide_2.note: regeneration-dependent ledger rows displayed on slide 2

regeneration_rows_slide_5.note: regeneration-dependent ledger rows displayed on slide 5

regeneration_rows_slide_8.note: regeneration-dependent ledger rows displayed on slide 8

regeneration_rows_slide_9.note: regeneration-dependent ledger rows displayed on slide 9

served_rows.note: rows in the cached test frame

verdict_go.note: GO only if the re-emission is byte-exact and the A layer regenerates from the cached probability file
